leadText:
The A-B-C Islands (Japanese: イロハ諸島 Iroha Archipelago) are an -exclusive group of islands located off the coast of Hoenn, between Lilycove City and Mossdeep City. They appeared in The Evolutionary War!.

 s who live on these islands have been engaged in an intense rivalry with each other over 's evolutionary line: with Island C believing are stronger, while Island B considers the stronger Evolution.

On Island A, Nurse Joy operates a Pokémon Center, which is also home to a school. The other two islands have transporter hubs connected to the Center, allowing for Trainers to transfer their Pokémon for treatment wherever they are. On Island B, DeepSeaScales can be found and used to evolve Clamperl into Gorebyss, while on Island C, DeepSeaTeeth can be found and used to evolve Clamperl into Huntail. Racing their Huntail and Gorebyss between the islands, as a result, is a common occurrence for the Trainers who reside there.

Known residents of the trio of islands include Nancy from Island C, while and live on Island B.

==Pokémon seen on the islands==
 

==Trivia==
The reefs off the shores of these islands resemble particular katakana characters. Island A's reefs make an I (イ), Island B's make a Ro (ロ) while Island C's make a Ha (ハ). This (along with the name of the archipelago) is a reference to , a traditional way of grouping kana characters. This is somewhat equivalent to western ABC's.
In the real world, the Dutch Caribbean Islands of , , and are commonly known as the "A-B-C Islands."
